question:

option_1: Put all your eggs in one basket
option_4: The early bird catches the worm
solution_text:
The correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. The early bird catches the worm.

 

IMPORTANT POINTS

• The idiom "The early bird catches the worm" means act early to succeed.

◦ (जल्दी करने वाला लाभ पाता है)

◦ Example: ‘The early bird catches the worm’ is generally used to refer to act early to succeed.

Therefore, the correct answer is: Option 4 i.e. The early bird catches the worm.

 

Additional Information

• Option 1: Put all your eggs in one basket (सब दांव पर लगाना): This idiom actually means risk everything, not the meaning given in the question.

◦ Example: ‘Put all your eggs in one basket’ is generally used to convey the idea of risk everything.

• Option 2: Stick to your guns (अडिग रहना): This idiom actually means stay firm, not the meaning given in the question.

◦ Example: ‘Stick to your guns’ is generally used to convey the idea of stay firm.

• Option 3: Sacred cow (आलोचना से परे): This idiom actually means cannot be criticized, not the meaning given in the question.

◦ Example: ‘Sacred cow’ is generally used to convey the idea of cannot be criticized.
